**Button:** “Hide draft”  
**Nearby message after hiding:** “Draft hidden. Your work is saved. **Restore draft**.”

Make “Restore draft” a keyboard-accessible action in the message and have screen readers announce “Draft hidden.” The 30-day retention rule still applies. The fixture doesn’t establish when that period starts or whether a restore action exists, so verify recovery before using the copy.

To check the proposal, hide a draft and restore it using the keyboard. Confirm the same draft returns with its contents intact and that other drafts and their retention dates stay unchanged. Nothing was modified.
